skill.displayName: Air Duct Cleaning Video — Before and After Marketing Videos for HVAC Duct Cleaning and Indoor Air Quality Services
skill.summary: Creates before-and-after HVAC duct cleaning videos to visually demonstrate indoor air quality improvements and cleaning effectiveness for customers.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Launch of Air Duct Cleaning Video assistant.

- Helps air duct cleaning and HVAC companies create compelling before-and-after marketing videos.
- Transforms inspection and cleaning footage into educational, urgency-creating clips for homeowners.
- Supports video content showing duct conditions, cleaning processes, and indoor air quality testing.
- Designed to boost customer trust and conversion by making invisible duct issues visible.
